claims.claim: OpenAI added GIF creation to ChatGPT using the Images 2.6 model, allowing users to generate animations from text prompts or photos and edit speed or frames.
claims.episode_span: OpenAI just added the ability to create animated GIFs inside ChatGPT using its new Images 2.6 model.
claims.source_title: ChatGPT can now turn text prompts and photos into animated GIFs with OpenAI's Images 2.6 model
claims.supporting_quote: ChatGPT can now create animated GIFs. The update is based on OpenAI's new Images 2.6 model and is rolling out to all ChatGPT and Codex users on web, desktop, and mobile apps, The Verge reports.

claims.claim: During its busiest week last quarter, Uber recorded only four rides booked through AI agents and around 500 Uber Eats orders placed by AI agents out of 320 million total trips and orders.
claims.episode_span: During the busy Halloween week, Uber handled hundreds of millions of trips, yet just four of them came from third-party AI agents trying to order rides on someone’s behalf.
claims.source_title: Almost no one uses AI agents to book their Uber, company says
claims.supporting_quote: the company handled around 320 million trips and orders across Uber and Uber Eats during the week of Halloween, but only 500 Uber Eats orders were placed by an AI agent.

claims.claim: Users now generate well over four billion images per week via ChatGPT and the API, one billion more than in September.
